say:4:1010516001:0.text: Now, allow me to present the masterpiece of tonight's banquet. Our most unique brew, crafted using only the best Gemvine grapes!
say:4:1010516001:0.source_cn: 现在，请允许我为诸位呈上今夜的珍宝！没错，正是由藤水晶...

say:5:1010516002:0.text: Tonight, everyone attending the Golden Banquet will have the opportunity to savor it.
say:5:1010516002:0.source_cn: 今夜，参加黄金晚宴的诸位都将品尝到它。

say:6:1010516003:0.text: At our current capacity, we can produce twenty thousand casks of brew per year. More than enough to fill the goblets of every noble in the royal capital, I'm sure!
say:6:1010516003:0.source_cn: 按照现在的产量，我们每年可以生产两万桶，足以供应王都所...

say:7:1010516004:0.text: Please believe me when I say this brew has the potential to add even more flavor to your lives!
say:7:1010516004:0.source_cn: 请诸位相信，这美味的藤水晶，必将为诸位今后的生活增光添彩！

say:9:1010516005:0.text: Oh? From what I've heard, bad weather resulted in awful harvests across the region. Northville's wheat and Southville's Gemvine grapes were both affected.
say:9:1010516005:0.source_cn: 哦？但……我最近听说，由于气候异变，别说是北村的小麦了...

say:10:1010516006:0.text: Could it be that Merlin's ward no longer works? In the future, will you still be able to grow these Gemvine grapes in Ryeham?
say:10:1010516006:0.source_cn: 梅林的加护，是否已经不再庇护这片土地了？未来，你还能继...
say:10:1010516006:0.male: Could it be that Merlin's ward no longer works? In the future, will you still be able to grow these Gemvine grapes in Ryeham?
say:10:1010516006:0.female: Could it be that Merlin's ward no longer works? In the future, will you still be able to grow these Gemvine grapes in Ryeham?

say:11:1010516007:0.text: No, milady... These are just rumors! Yes, that's it! Baseless, fear-mongering rumors, and nothing more!
say:11:1010516007:0.source_cn: 不不不……夫人，这是流言……不！是谎言！是彻头彻尾的谎言。

say:12:1010516008:0.text: With the decades-long disappearance of Merlin, it's only natural that the protection over Ryeham has been compromised. But I can assure you it has not affected me in the least!
say:12:1010516008:0.source_cn: 大魔法师梅林失踪了几十年，金穗村的加护受到影响，一点也...
say:12:1010516008:0.male: With the decades-long disappearance of Merlin, it's only natural that the protection over Ryeham has been compromised. But I can assure you it has not affected me in the least!
say:12:1010516008:0.female: With the decades-long disappearance of Merlin, it's only natural that the protection over Ryeham has been compromised. But I can assure you it has not affected me in the least!

say:13:1010516009:0.text: Hmm... Perhaps so, but Southville's output isn't nearly enough to sustain your grandiose promises.
say:13:1010516009:0.source_cn: 呵……就算如此，光靠南村那点产量根本不够。你在说大话。

say:14:1010516010:0.text: I have already spoken to the residents of Northville, my lady. They will begin sowing our grapes as soon as the weather allows. No need to worry.
say:14:1010516010:0.source_cn: 夫人，我们已经说服北村的村民了，他们近些天便会铲掉麦田...

say:18:1010516011:0.text: That jerk, I can't believe he's...
say:18:1010516011:0.source_cn: 这个混球，果然一开始就——

say:20:1010516013:0.text: Hey! What the heck are you guys doing here?

say:22:1010516014:0.text: Ouch! Sorry! Someone stepped on my foot just now and pulled off a bunch of hair... It really hurts...
say:22:1010516014:0.source_cn: 对不起！刚刚有人踩到我毛茸茸的脚了！我的毛都被踩掉了…...

say:23:1010516015:0.text: So you just jumped up and knocked over the table? You dumb rabbit!
say:23:1010516015:0.source_cn: 所以你就蹦起来打翻了酒台是吗？你这蠢兔子！

say:25:1010516016:0.text: You there, hiding near the rack! Show yourself!
say:25:1010516016:0.source_cn: 谁？！到底是什么人躲在那里！

say:26:1010516017:0.text: Guards! Throws these meddling interlopers out right this second!
say:26:1010516017:0.source_cn: 守卫！守卫！来人！把这些混球给我拉出去！

say:27:1010516018:0.text: Ah... I knew it would come to this, sooner or later.
say:27:1010516018:0.source_cn: 啊……我就知道迟早会变成这样。

say:28:1010516019:0.text: Looks like our game of hide-and-seek is over, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Get ready to fight!
say:28:1010516019:0.male: Looks like our game of hide-and-seek is over, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Get ready to fight!
say:28:1010516019:0.female: Looks like our game of hide-and-seek is over, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Get ready to fight!

say:29:1010516020:0.text: Wait, what is that thing? Is that a Hypofiend?
say:29:1010516020:0.source_cn: 等等！你们看那是什么东西？魔物吗！

say:32:1010516021:0.text: It looks way stronger than anything we've faced so far! Be careful!
say:32:1010516021:0.source_cn: 这只魔物非常强大，比我们之前见过的任何一只都更加强大！...

narration:34:10106221:0.text: The banquet officially begins as Lord Franz and the guests enter.
narration:34:10106221:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨和宾客们相继入场，宴会正式开始。
